card.name: Old book prose and citations
card.fires_on: Scattered words in old public-domain book text, such as 19th-century essays, natural history works and their volume and page citations. Hits include 'p' after 'vol. ii.' and linking words in long argument sentences.

modes.label: Citation pieces
modes.description: The 'p' or volume number inside an old book reference like 'vol. ii. p. 452'.
